prompt: Do these steps in order, exactly one tool call per step, and continue even if a step fails: 1) Use Write to create notes.txt containing the single word alpha. 2) Use Read on notes.txt. 3) Use Edit to change alpha to beta in notes.txt. 4) Use Glob with pattern *.txt. 5) Use Grep to search for beta. 6) Use Bash to run: echo hello. 7) Use Bash to run: ls does-not-exist-dir. 8) Use the Agent tool with a general-purpose subagent that uses Read on notes.txt and reports its contents. Then reply DONE.
